name: @gavin-hu/my-pi-agent
description: Personal Pi customizations, packaged as a Pi package: worktree, ask-user-question, todo, plan-mode, web-search, web-fetch, status-bar, and guard.
author: Gavin Hu

scripts.transpile: bun build extensions/worktree/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-worktree-index.js && bun build extensions/ask-user-question/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-ask-user-question-index.js && bun build extensions/todo/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-todo-index.js && bun build extensions/plan-mode/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-plan-mode-index.js && bun build extensions/web-search/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-web-search-index.js && bun build extensions/web-fetch/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-web-fetch-index.js && bun build extensions/status-bar/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-status-bar-index.js && bun build extensions/guard/index.ts --no-bundle --external '*' --target=node --outfile=/tmp/pi-guard-index.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run transpile && bun run test && bun run smoke
